elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires IBM, upon expiration or termination, to provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies IBM's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor must return all Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: IBM must return all Content and other Customer data within thirty (30) days following the stated expiration or termination trigger.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: IBM must thereafter delete the returned Content and data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion after it occurs.
elements.evidence: IBM must certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance following expiration or termination, at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: IBM must return all Content and other Customer data in machine-readable form within thirty (30) days.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred and fallback requirement. However, it applies the return and deletion duties to termination of any single Service Option Attachment while requiring return and deletion of all Content and Customer data. That is broader than necessary and could impair still-active Service Option Attachments, notwithstanding the final sentence preserving payment obligations under those attachments. The duties should be limited to data associated with the terminated attachment when the remainder of the Agreement continues.
